purpose: Install and verify official OKX Onchain OS tooling on BLACK for ORACL3 A2MCP registration readiness. Owner has already authorized OKX participation. Do not create a new wallet, do not move funds, and do not expose credentials.
command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===NODE==='; node -v; echo '===NPM==='; npm -v; echo '===ONCHAIN_INSTALL==='; npx -y @okxweb3/onchainos-installer install; echo '===POST_INSTALL==='; (command -v onchainos || true); (onchainos --version || true); echo '===NPM_GLOBAL==='; npm root -g; echo '===OKX_SKILL_FILES==='; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 \( -iname '*onchainos*' -o -iname '*okx*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
